currentParagraphText: “Seeking Forbidden Knowledge is a risky endeavor,” the First Sage said.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Seeking Forbidden Knowledge is a risky endeavor,” the First Sage said.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “While the curiosity is natural, the system does not classify something as Forbidden Knowledge for no reason. More often than not, it’s protecting someone from learning something that will have a very detrimental effect on them. To restrict one from knowledge one isn’t ready for yet.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Now, I did think it was perhaps just to pass the time, as sometimes one wants to fast-travel through eternity a little, but that felt wrong. It’s probably a factor, but not the main reason. No, Meditate has to serve some other kind of function that’s shared by the gods. A crucial one that the system wants to keep hidden.”
